import { test, expect } from './support/forge';

test('desktop prototype filters, saves and restores its sample', async ({ page, webview }, testInfo) => {
  const errors: string[] = [];
  page.on('pageerror', error => errors.push(error.message));
  page.on('console', message => { if (message.type() === 'error') errors.push(message.text()); });
  page.on('request', request => {
    const url = new URL(request.url());
    if (url.protocol.startsWith('http') && url.origin !== new URL(webview.url).origin) errors.push(`External request: ${url.origin}`);
  });
  await page.goto(webview.url);
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'A place to start.' })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText('Sample data · this tab only')).toBeVisible();
  expect(new URLSearchParams(new URL(page.url()).hash.slice(1)).has('token')).toBe(false);
  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save Shape the brief' }).locator('svg')).toBeVisible();
  await page.screenshot({ path: testInfo.outputPath('desktop.png'), fullPage: true });
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save Shape the brief' }).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Unsave Shape the brief' })).toHaveAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Unsave Shape the brief' }).locator('svg')).toBeVisible();
  await page.getByLabel('Find an idea').fill('no matching idea');
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'No ideas match your search' })).toBeVisible();
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Clear search' }).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole('listitem')).toHaveCount(3);
  await page.reload();
  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save Shape the brief' })).toHaveAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
  expect(errors).toEqual([]);
});

test('mobile view fits and exposes comfortable controls', async ({ page, webview }, testInfo) => {
  await page.setViewportSize({ width: 390, height: 844 });
  await page.goto(webview.url);
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Prototype ideas' })).toBeVisible();
  expect(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= window.innerWidth)).toBe(true);
  const save = page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save Shape the brief' });
  expect((await save.boundingBox())?.height).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(44);
  await page.screenshot({ path: testInfo.outputPath('mobile.png'), fullPage: true });
  await save.click();
  await expect(page.getByRole('status')).toHaveText('Shape the brief saved.');
});

test('keyboard reaches the main content and performs the interaction', async ({ page, webview }) => {
  await page.goto(webview.url);
  await page.keyboard.press('Tab');
  await expect(page.getByRole('link', { name: 'Skip to content' })).toBeFocused();
  await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
  await expect(page.getByRole('main')).toBeFocused();
  await page.keyboard.press('Tab');
  await expect(page.getByLabel('Find an idea')).toBeFocused();
  await page.keyboard.press('Tab');
  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save Shape the brief' })).toBeFocused();
  await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Unsave Shape the brief' })).toHaveAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
});
